instruction: Explain what QLoRA is in simple terms.
output: QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation) is a fine-tuning technique that loads a large language model in 4-bit precision to save memory, then trains only a small set of added low-rank adapter weights instead of the full model. This lets you fine-tune multi-billion parameter models on a single consumer GPU.
